thought: I can’t trust anyone here

speech.text: Your loan’s due tomorrow, remember?

name: Malik Reyes
action: taps foot impatiently
thought: They think I’m just a kid

speech.text: Don’t think I’m scared of you.

action: twists her ring
thought: He’ll bite when I push him

speech.text: You owe me for the corner.

name: Booker Lyle
action: counts chips quietly
thought: Everyone's debt is a lever

speech.text: Pay up, or I’ll take it elsewhere.

name: Amara Bello
action: checks radio dial
thought: He’ll never learn

speech.text: Your games won’t work on me.

action: stares at a blank wall
thought: I’m waiting for the next call

name: Rey Vasquez
action: flips a channel

event: There is a funeral on Delmar. Most of the block goes. Some people who should be there are not.
An ambulance takes someone out of the Terraces before dawn. Nobody says a name.

name: The Blue Spoon
text: Hoarding goes up around the shell of The Blue Spoon.

action: Rey Vasquez puts Dez Okonkwo against a wall at Spin Cycle over what they were fronted. People stop to watch.

text: Malik Reyes fronted cash and expects it back — Dez Okonkwo.

thought: I’m not backing down, even if he’s bigger

speech.text: You still owe me, you know that

name: Rey Vasquez
action: leans back, eyes narrowed
thought: He thinks he can push me around again

speech.text: Hands off, I’m not paying until you quit

name: Malik Reyes
action: fidgets, glances at his siblings
thought: Need to prove I’m not a kid

speech.text: You think I’m just a kid here?

thought: These envelopes never end

speech.text: Got the intel you asked for yet?

thought: He’s always late with the files

thought: She’ll need a plan soon

action: flips a page, glances at Tiny
thought: What’s really happening here?

thought: He thinks five days gives him the right to shake me in broad daylight.

speech.text: You touched me once today, Rey. Do not try it twice.

action: steps closer to the counter without looking away
thought: He hides behind that counter like the wood will pay what he owes.

speech.text: Five days late, Dez. The product moves today or we have real problems.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: stacks quarters neatly on the worn wood counter
thought: Kohl looks like a man waiting for his badge to melt.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: shifts his weight away from the counter and Cass
thought: Deveaux wants me rattled in front of Ivy. It will not happen.

speech.text: Count your coins and mind your own business, Cass.

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: slides the receipt clipboard across to the deliveryman
thought: Too much cold air blowing through the door with these two snarling.

speech.text: Do not start your games across my counter, Deveaux. Take your change.

name: Booker Lyle
action: straightens a tray of unpawned gold watches
thought: Let them freeze on the corner. The warm shop brings them here eventually.

speech.text: Going to drop ten degrees by sunset, Doyle. Keep that door shut.

name: Malik Reyes
action: pulls his thin coat tight against the concrete wall
thought: Dez is going to blame me the minute Vasquez presses him harder.

speech.text: Mind your own business, Cass. I'm off duty soon.

thought: The register never lies, even when the rest of them do.

speech.text: Check the lock on the back case before we close.
